behavior: What the original 1.13c DS1 loader makes of a map the editor saved, compared with the intended map at the loader's return stage

format_upgrade_to_v18.note: sources of every shipped version family re-saved

object_id_remap.note: compared only through the loader on both sides (independent reference encoding)

domain.description: editor-saved maps (writer always version 18) covering each writer feature of design section 10, plus the vanilla corpus's own files through the same loader; not every possible map

limitations: Loader-return stage only: room instantiation, DT1 resolution and rendering are not observed.
Raw file object IDs are not observable at this stage (remapped by act/version tables); they are compared only via an independent encoding loaded by the same function.
The tail slack is zero-filled; the game's own allocation slack is uninitialised heap, so maps relying on bytes past end-of-file are compared under zero slack.
The file read is substituted (12 bytes patched for the duration of one call); file lookup/MPQ precedence is not part of this contract.
Fields the loader never reads (the tileset name list, the v18 pre-group dword, the group record's 0x10 slot) are covered by editor preservation tests, not here.
Natural cache records are a later stage for instantiated maps (tile dwords flagged in place); only the direct route is compared.

native_quirks.detail: below version 4 the loader points record[15] at the floor block but leaves the floor-layer count (record[6]) 0; compared as floor0_unlisted. Re-saving at v18 makes the count 1.
the loader keeps objects outside width*5 x height*5; the editor's reader discards them (src/core/ds1.c), so a re-save drops them
native_quirks.evidence: live: 80 objects in 38 vanilla maps (e.g. act1 catacomb catsdown.ds1 type 2 id 17 at 194,19)

native_quirks.detail: objects are prepended; a path attaches to the first list node at its (x,y) = the last such object in file order

abi_recipe.caller_contract: caller zeroes the 0x5c-byte record (REP STOSD ECX=0x17 at 0x6fd5beef) before the call; the data-table preload passes pool 0 (LoadLevelPresetData 0x6fdc05bc)
abi_recipe.convention: custom stdcall: 2 stack dwords (record*, file name*), callee pops 8 (RET 8); EAX = memory pool, consumed only by the file read at 0xb56b; EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP saved and initialised inside
evidence: live 2026-10-22, member lod-113c slot 1 (exe sha256 74fe9c09...): direct-route records of LRiverC/Cott5 equal the game's own natural cache records field for field (incl. remapped object ids); TownS1's natural record differs only by tile dwords the game flags in place after instantiating the town (a later stage)
live 2026-10-22: all 2276 manifest DS1s through the direct route vs the editor's reading of the same bytes: 2238 equal, 38 differ only by out-of-bounds objects the editor discards
abi_recipe.file_read: push 0; push eax; mov eax,[esp+0x38]; call RESOURCE_AllocateAndOpen(0x6fd59900) = 6a00508b442438e889e3ffff at RVA 0xb56b; the callee pops its 2 arguments (stdcall), so the 12 bytes are stack-neutral; it returns a buffer of filesize+800 bytes (Archive.cpp line 0xcf)
abi_recipe.hidden_state: reads sgptDataTables(+0xa80), the monster remap tables at 0x6fdf0980..0x6fdf09b4, the act object table at 0x6fdee2c8, the legacy orientation table at 0x6fddbcc0 and the item-code table at 0x6fdeee80; allocates object/group/path nodes from pool 0 (not freed; small)
abi_recipe.observation: direct: the 12 file-read bytes are replaced for one call by mov eax,<buffer>; nop*7 and restored and read back immediately after; the buffer is the file followed by 800 zero bytes. natural: walk the preset cache at D2Common+0xa147c (name[0x104], refcount@0x104, record@0x108, next@0x10c)
abi_recipe.record_layout: dwords: 0 tagType, 1 buffer, 3 width-1, 4 height-1, 5 wall layers, 6 floor layers, 7..10 orientation[], 11..14 wall tiles[], 15..16 floor tiles[], 17 shadow, 18 tag (tagType 1/2 or v<4), 19 group count, 20 groups (0x18: x,y,w,h,-,unk@0x14 v>=13), 21 objects (0x20 nodes: unit type, id, x, next, path{count, (action,x,y)[]}, type, y, flags; prepended)
abi_recipe.relocations: none applied: D2Common.dll must be at its preferred base 0x6fd50000 (checked) and its whole .text must equal the baseline (checked before any call)
abi_recipe.symbol: LoadAndParsePresetArchive (Ghidra name); sole caller GetOrCreatePresetFileCacheEntry 0x6fd5be50 (call site 0x6fd5bf35)

stage: LoadAndParsePresetArchive return (before room instantiation; instantiated maps have tile dwords flagged in place, so natural cache records of loaded areas are a later stage)
